app.name: Sahayak
checkin.title: Check in at {clinic}
checkin.name: Your name
checkin.consent.visit: I agree that the clinic may store my name, phone number and visit details to manage my visit.
checkin.consent.whatsapp: I agree to receive messages about my visit on WhatsApp.
checkin.consent.reminders: I agree to receive appointment reminders and follow-up messages.
checkin.token_issued: Your token number is {token}. About {wait} minutes to go.
checkin.consent_required: Consent to store visit details is needed to check in.
console.llm_down: The assistant is temporarily unavailable. Check-in and the patient queue still work.
console.red_flag_alert: URGENT: possible emergency reported by a patient
msg.token_issued: Hello {name}, your token at {clinic} is {token}. Estimated wait: {wait} minutes.
msg.your_turn: {name}, it is your turn. Please go to {doctor}'s room. (Token {token})
msg.next_soon: {name}, you are next. Please be ready near the doctor's room.
msg.red_flag: This may be an emergency. Please go to the nearest emergency room or call 108 right now. We have alerted the clinic team.
msg.medical_advice: I can't advise on that, but I've told the doctor's team right away.
msg.human_handoff: I'm connecting you to our receptionist. Someone will reply shortly.
msg.not_in_settings: I don't have that information. I've asked the receptionist to help you.
msg.greeting: Hello! I'm Sahayak, the clinic's assistant. I can help with timings, directions and appointments.
msg.booked: Your appointment with {doctor} is booked for {when}.
msg.slot_taken: Sorry, that slot is not available. Here are other options: {options}
msg.slots: Available slots with {doctor}: {options}. Reply with the one you want.
msg.no_slots: No free slots right now. I've asked the receptionist to help you.
msg.intake_intro: While you wait, a few quick questions for the doctor.
msg.intake_done: Thank you. I've shared your answers with the doctor.
msg.late_notice: {doctor} is running about {minutes} minutes late today. Your new time is {when}. Reply 1 to keep it, or 2 to see other slots.
msg.late_kept: Thank you, your appointment stays at {when}.
msg.rebook_needed: Your appointment needs a new time. Please choose: {options}
msg.followup_reminder: Reminder from {clinic}: your appointment is on {when}.
msg.followup_checkin: Hello {name}, how are you feeling after your visit? Reply and we'll let the doctor know if you need anything.
msg.lead_welcome: Welcome to {clinic}! I can tell you our timings and book you a slot with {doctor}. Would you like to book?
msg.consent_needed: Before I can message you, please give consent at the clinic or reply YES to receive messages from {clinic}.
msg.llm_fallback: Thanks for your message. The receptionist will reply shortly.
msg.pick_doctor: Which doctor would you like to see? {options}
msg.ask_name: Happy to help you book. May I have your name, please?
msg.ask_consent_lead: Thanks {name}. To book, the clinic needs to save your name and phone number. Reply YES to agree.
msg.lead_declined: No problem, I have not saved anything. You can still ask me about timings and directions.
msg.queue_status: Your token is {token}. {ahead} patient(s) ahead of you, about {wait} minutes.
msg.queue_called: Your token {token} has been called. Please go to the doctor's room.
msg.not_in_queue: You are not in today's queue. Scan the QR code at the clinic to check in.
msg.queue_no_reorder: The queue runs in order of arrival and I can't change it. If you need urgent attention, please tell the receptionist.
msg.didnt_understand: Sorry, I didn't get that. Please reply with a number from the list, or ask the receptionist.
msg.late_reply_options: Other slots with {doctor}: {options}. Reply with the number you want.
msg.recall: Hello {name}, it has been a while since your last visit to {clinic}. Reply BOOK if you would like a check-up.
msg.followup_ack: Thank you, I've passed this to the doctor's team.
msg.followup_worse: I've alerted the doctor's team right away. If this feels like an emergency, go to the nearest hospital or call 108.
msg.come_now: {name}, we called your token {token}. Please come to {doctor}'s room now.
msg.no_show: Your token {token} was marked as missed. Please speak to the receptionist to rejoin the queue.
msg.ask_pref: Which day and time suits you with {doctor}? For example "tomorrow evening", "Monday 5 pm", or "earliest".
msg.pref_not_understood: Sorry, I didn't catch the day or time. Please tell me like "tomorrow morning", "Friday after 4 pm", or say "earliest".
msg.slots_nearest: Nothing is free at that time. The nearest options with {doctor}: {options}. Reply with the number you want.
msg.confirm_single: The next available time with {doctor} is {options}. Reply YES to book it, or tell me another day or time.
msg.ask_reminders: Would you like a WhatsApp reminder before your appointment? Reply YES to get one, or NO.
msg.reminders_on: Done. I'll remind you before your appointment. Reply STOP any time to stop messages.
msg.reminders_off: No problem, no reminders will be sent.
msg.my_data: Here is what the clinic holds about you: name {name}, phone {phone}, {visits} visit(s), {appointments} appointment(s), {messages} chat message(s). Consents active: {consents}. To delete everything, reply DELETE MY DATA. To stop messages, reply STOP.
msg.confirm_erase: This will permanently erase your name, phone number, chats and intake answers from the clinic's system. Reply DELETE to confirm, or anything else to cancel.
msg.erased: Your data has been erased from the clinic's system. Thank you.
msg.stopped: You will not receive any more messages from {clinic}, except replies when you write to us. Reply START if you change your mind.
msg.started: Thanks, messages are back on for reminders and updates.
msg.no_data_held: I don't have a patient record for this number. If you want this chat removed, reply DELETE.
ask.help: I can answer questions like: how many patients today / this week, who didn't show up yesterday, appointments tomorrow, average waiting time, busiest hours, cancellations, new patients, open alerts. Say "brief" for today's summary.
ask.messages: {n} patient message(s) {label}, {human} chat(s) handled by a person.
brief.title: Daily summary for {clinic}, {date}
brief.alerts: Emergency alerts today: {n}. Open items on the console: {open}
brief.messages: Patient messages today: {n} ({human} handled by a person)
brief.quiet: A quiet day: nothing needs your attention.
msg.erased_partial: Your chats, contact preferences and reminders have been deleted. Medical records signed by the doctor must be kept until {date} as medical-record rules require; they are visible only to the clinic and will be deleted automatically after that date.
msg.media_received: Received your {file}. It has been added to your record and the doctor will see it.
msg.media_unknown: I can't attach files for this number yet. Please check in at the clinic or book an appointment first.
msg.media_unsupported: Sorry, I can only accept photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP) and PDF files.
msg.media_too_large: That file is too large. Please send a file under 8 MB.
doc.cert.sick_leave: This is to certify that {name} ({age}) was examined at this clinic on {date} and is advised rest on medical grounds for {days} day(s), from {from} to {to}.
doc.cert.fitness: This is to certify that {name} ({age}) was examined at this clinic on {date} and is found medically fit {purpose}.
doc.cert.attendance: This is to certify that {name} ({age}) attended this clinic on {date} for a medical consultation.
doc.signed_by: Digitally signed by {doctor}, Reg. No. {reg}, on {date}
doc.disclaimer: Electronically generated document, valid only with its verification code.
msg.document_ready: {doctor} has issued your {kind} (no. {number}). Download it here: {link} . The link works for {days} days.
msg.review_ask: Hello {name}, how was your visit with {doctor} at {clinic}? Reply with a number from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent). Your answer goes to the clinic team.
msg.review_link: If you would like to share your experience publicly, you can do it here (optional): {link}
msg.review_sorry: Sorry we did not meet your expectations. If you like, tell us what we could do better. The clinic team will read it.
msg.review_comment_thanks: Thank you, I have passed your comment to the clinic team.
ask.ratings: Average rating {label}: {avg} out of 5 from {n} rating(s); {low} low (3 or below).
msg.custom_footer: Reply STOP to stop these messages.
msg.waitlist_offer: {clinic}: A cancellation slot is available at {time}. Reply ACCEPT {code} before {expires} to book it. Otherwise this offer expires. Reply STOP to stop messages.
msg.waitlist_accepted: Your cancellation-slot appointment is booked. Contact the clinic if you need help.
msg.waitlist_unavailable: This offer is no longer available. Please contact the receptionist for another appointment.
msg.clinic_menu: Hello! Welcome to {clinic}. Reply with an option: 1) Book an appointment 2) Clinic timings 3) Address 4) Talk to reception.
msg.clinic_visit: Is this your first visit or a follow-up? Reply 1 for First visit, or 2 for Follow-up.
msg.clinic_confirm: Confirm your appointment with {doctor} at {when}? Reply YES to book or NO to choose another time.
msg.choice_stale: That option is from an earlier step. Please use the latest options, or type your reply.
msg.voice_reception: This call assistant can book a new appointment and explain clinic timings. For existing appointments, personal records or account changes, please contact reception. No live transfer is available.
msg.voice_link: Start a voice conversation with the AI receptionist using the private link below. Your booking will continue from here. The link works once and expires in 15 minutes. Keep it private. This opens an internet call in your browser; it does not ring your phone.
msg.voice_resume: Let us continue your appointment booking. What would you like to do?
